Samarcande Voyage

A website for a tour operator serving French-speaking travellers: route, day-by-day itinerary, cities and gallery.

Scope
Multi-page
Timeline
4–5 days
Language
FR
Year
2026
samarcande-voyage

The brief

An Uzbek tour operator sells trips to travellers from France. They needed a French-language site that presents the country and the route so a French tourist instantly understands what they're paying for.

What we did

  • DestinationsCity cards: Samarkand, Bukhara, Khiva, Shakhrisabz and a yurt camp.
  • Day-by-day itineraryA 12-day route, each day with its own photo and description.
  • Gallery and agency pageRoute photos and the agency's story, to build trust before booking.
  • Client photo reviewWe reviewed every batch of photos, removed duplicates and flagged images that need the author's permission.
  • Fully in FrenchCopy and interface made for the French-speaking market.
